translation: These are three formula definitions, not assertions, and none has any hypotheses. Write R₀(xᵢ, xⱼ) for the atom with relation label 0 and variable arguments i and j, in that order. Def16 takes any natural number a and then any natural number b, not necessarily distinct, and returns R₀(xₐ, xᵦ). Def17 is the object-language formula “for every x₀, K(¬R₀(x₀, x₀)) if and only if R₀(x₁, x₀).” The quantifier scopes over the entire biconditional; x₁ is free, and K applies only to the negated atom on the left. Def18 is the object-language formula ¬R₀(x₁, x₁), with both occurrences of x₁ free.
